p: accursed thing: In taking that which was commanded to be destroyed.
Ai: This was a city of the Amorites: for there was another so called among the Amorites, Jer 49:3. The first Ai is called Aiah, Isa 10:28.
men of Ai smote of them: God would by this overthrow make them more earnest to search out and punish the sin committed.
other side Jordan: This infirmity of his faith shows how we are inclined by nature to distrust.
name: When your enemies will blaspheme you and say that you were not able to defend us from them.
destroy the accursed from among you: Then to allow wickedness unpunished, is to refuse God willingly.
accursed thing from among you: Meaning, the man that took of the thing forbidden.
taken with the accursed thing shall: That is found guilty, either by lots, or by the judgment of Urim. Nu 27:21.
make confession unto him: By declaring truth: for God is glorified when the truth is confessed.
Babylonish garment: Such a rich garment as the states of Babylon wore.
wedge of gold: Some read a plate: others, a rod, and some a tongue.
sons: This judgment belonged only to God, and to whom he will reveal it. He had commanded man not to punish the child for the father's sins, De 24:16.
Why hast thou troubled us: He declares that this is God's judgment because he had offended, and caused others to be slain.
